summary: Tested Careplus marketing site — 6 backend endpoints (15 pytest tests, 100% pass) and end-to-end frontend flows (24/25 pass). One real integration bug found: Survey form submission fails with 422 when optional email is left blank.

minor.issue: EmailStr field rejects empty string with 422. Frontend sends email:'' which fails validation. Either backend should accept '' as None for optional EmailStr fields, or frontend must omit empty optional email keys before POST.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/survey returns 422 'value is not a valid email address' when user does not enter an email (email='' is sent). Toast 'Something went wrong' shown. ReferralForm correctly deletes empty referrer_email, but Resources.jsx submit() does not strip empty optional fields.

action_items: Fix Survey form (Resources.jsx submit): strip empty optional fields before POST, e.g., `const payload = { ...form, rating: Number(form.rating) }; if (!payload.email) delete payload.email; if (!payload.name) delete payload.name;` — mirrors the existing pattern used in ReferralForm.

Optional hardening: in backend, convert '' to None for Optional[EmailStr] across SurveyCreate/ReferralCreate/AppointmentCreate/ContactCreate (use a validator) so future frontends don't hit the same trap.
critical_code_review_comments: Resources.jsx: survey submit always sends email even if blank — blocks submission. Same defensive cleanup as ReferralForm should be applied.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') (deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handler). Not blocking.
Backend POST endpoints return 200 instead of 201 for resource creation — minor REST semantics issue, not blocking.
Home.jsx 'Service Areas' QuickCard links to /contact but eyebrow promises 'View areas' — misleading; could route to dedicated section or About.
GET /api/contact and /api/referrals expose all submissions publicly without auth — acceptable for marketing MVP but should be flagged: any visitor can list PII.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed records via backend tests and frontend submission flows in contacts, referrals, surveys, appointments collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints (health, services, contact, referrals, survey, appointments) with create→GET persistence and validation checks. Survey 422 bug is reproducible via: curl -X POST $API/survey -d '{"rating":4,"feedback":"x","email":""}'. After main agent fix, re-run pytest and re-test the Resources page survey submission with empty email field.
rca of the issue: Pydantic v2 EmailStr does not coerce empty string to None for Optional[EmailStr] fields — it triggers 422. Resources.jsx Survey form initialState has email:'' and the submit handler posts the form unmodified (unlike ReferralForm which strips empty referrer_email). Fix: replicate the strip pattern in Resources.jsx submit() or add a Pydantic field validator on the backend that converts empty strings to None.
